summary: Reduce to the abstract `TwistingData.hasType_twisted_hecke`: columns are functions on classes (`freeLevelEquiv`); the Hecke operator at l is a sum over the cosets of the parahoric P of pullbacks by d = diag(p·1_𝔯, 1), which, after decomposing ρ_x·δ_b = γ·ρ·u with rational γ, act on values by the weight representation of γ: at the letters (tops inducing l or l̄) this is the twisted letter representation, elsewhere an integral invertible matrix. Then check: the image is the integral columns, the operator formula, and the injectivity of the source map.

steps.lean: have q : D.X 0 ≃ Fin D.k := equivFinOfCardEq (by simp [↓card_X, n])

steps.claim: P := the parahoric subgroup of GL_k(W) of the two-block labelling (𝔯, k − 𝔯).
steps.lean: let P := parahoric W (twoBlock D.k (D.ceilLogM p))

steps.claim: ϖ := p as a unit of E; d := diag(ϖ on the first 𝔯 coordinates, 1 elsewhere).
steps.lean:
let ϖ : D.Eˣ := .mk0 p NeZero.out
  let d := diagGL (if q · < D.ceilLogM p then ϖ else 1)

steps.claim: jw: GL_k(W) → GL(X_0)(E) by reindexing; j_v: GL(X_0)(E) → GL(X_0)(E_v).
steps.lean:
let jw := (GeneralLinearGroup.map W.subtype).comp (reindexGL q.symm).toMonoidHom
  let j v := GeneralLinearGroup.map (n := D.X 0) (algebraMap D.E (@LocField D.E _ _ v))

steps.claim: hM: j_v(x) ∈ K_v iff x has entries (and inverse) in the valuation subring at v.
steps.lean:
have hM {v x} : j v x ∈ Kw .. ↔ x ∈ intGL _ (v.valuation D.E).valuationSubring.1 := by
    simp [mem_intGL, ← v_algebraMap_eq_valuation, -coe_units_inv]; rfl
steps.typed_fact: j v x ∈ Kw .. ↔ x ∈ intGL _ (v.valuation D.E).valuationSubring.1

steps.claim: Unfold integrality through the valuation of the embedding.
steps.lean: simp [mem_intGL, ← v_algebraMap_eq_valuation, -coe_units_inv]; rfl

steps.claim: Facts: W is that subring; its residue field is finite; class representatives ρ integral above p (`exists_reps_integralAbove`); l is split; maxCompactAt l ≤ columnLevel 0; p ∈ l; v_l(p) = e^{−1}; the sizes.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨rfl, _, ⟨ρ, hρ, hρ'⟩, hl, hv, hpl, hl', ⟨⟩⟩ := hW, T.finite_residueField,
    exists_reps_integralAbove (K := D.columnLevel 0) p, L.star_ne a,
    L.maxCompactAt_le_columnLevel a, L.p_mem a, L.valuation_p a, id big

steps.claim: hP: j_l(d⁻¹·jw(β)·d) ∈ K_l iff β ∈ P.
steps.lean:
have hP {β} : j l (d⁻¹ * jw β * d) ∈ Kw .. ↔ β ∈ P := by
    have H β : (∀ i j, l.valuation _ ((d⁻¹ * jw β * d) i j) ≤ 1) ↔ β ∈ P := q.forall₂_congr q (by
      intros; dsimp [twoBlock]
      split_ifs <;> simp [*, d, jw, ← map_inv, field, ϖ, ↓OrderDual.toDual_lt_toDual,
        -WithZero.inv_exp, ← WithZero.exp_add, ← lt_mul_exp_iff_le, ↓Valuation.mem_maximalIdeal_iff]
          <;> first
        | use (β _ _).2.trans_lt (by trivial)
        | use (mul_le_one' (β _ _).2 (by trivial)).trans_lt (by trivial))
    erw [hM, mem_intGL, conj_inv, H, H β⁻¹]; simp
steps.typed_fact: j l (d⁻¹ * jw β * d) ∈ Kw .. ↔ β ∈ P

steps.claim: H: the entries of d⁻¹·jw(β)·d are all l-integral iff β ∈ P.
steps.lean:
have H β : (∀ i j, l.valuation _ ((d⁻¹ * jw β * d) i j) ≤ 1) ↔ β ∈ P := q.forall₂_congr q (by
      intros; dsimp [twoBlock]
      split_ifs <;> simp [*, d, jw, ← map_inv, field, ϖ, ↓OrderDual.toDual_lt_toDual,
        -WithZero.inv_exp, ← WithZero.exp_add, ← lt_mul_exp_iff_le, ↓Valuation.mem_maximalIdeal_iff]
          <;> first
        | use (β _ _).2.trans_lt (by trivial)
        | use (mul_le_one' (β _ _).2 (by trivial)).trans_lt (by trivial))
steps.typed_fact: (∀ i j, l.valuation _ ((d⁻¹ * jw β * d) i j) ≤ 1) ↔ β ∈ P

steps.claim: Compare entry by entry through q.
steps.lean: intros; dsimp [twoBlock]

steps.claim: Entry (i, j) is p^{[j<𝔯] − [i<𝔯]}·β_{ij}: integral iff β_{ij} lies in the maximal ideal whenever i ≥ 𝔯 > j (the parahoric condition); case analysis on the blocks.
steps.lean:
split_ifs <;> simp [*, d, jw, ← map_inv, field, ϖ, ↓OrderDual.toDual_lt_toDual,
        -WithZero.inv_exp, ← WithZero.exp_add, ← lt_mul_exp_iff_le, ↓Valuation.mem_maximalIdeal_iff]
          <;> first
        | use (β _ _).2.trans_lt (by trivial)
        | use (mul_le_one' (β _ _).2 (by trivial)).trans_lt (by trivial))

steps.claim: Combine with hM for the element and its inverse.
steps.lean: erw [hM, mem_intGL, conj_inv, H, H β⁻¹]; simp

steps.claim: ψ: at a place where κ_τ is a single row of length b (b = a at tops, 0 elsewhere), the Schur matrix is the symmetric-power matrix (`schur_one_row_eq_symPowMatrix`).
steps.lean:
choose ψ hψ using fun {τ b} (h : ite (τ ∈ D.tops) D.a 0 = b) ↦ schur_one_row_eq_symPowMatrix (k :=
    D.κ τ) (a := b) q.symm (by simp [↓card_X, n]; omega) (by grind only [card_X, κ, n])

steps.claim: The v-component of the embedding of a rational γ is j_v(γ).
steps.lean:
have hj v γ : ((stdSpace ..).embFin γ).atPlace v =
    j v γ := congr(.map (_root_.evalAt v) $(stdSpace_embFin γ))

steps.claim: hw′: an element of K_l lies in the image of jw (it is in GL_k(W)).
steps.lean: have hw' {x} : _ ↔ x ∈ jw.range := hM.trans (reindex_equiv (reindexGL _)).2.1

steps.claim: hD: j_l(d) lies in the basic double coset of index 𝔯 at l (`diagGL_mem_basicDoubleCoset`).
steps.lean:
have hD : j l d ∈ basicDoubleCoset _ l (D.ceilLogM p) := by convert (diagGL_mem_basicDoubleCoset
    (ϖ := ϖ.map _) ((v_algebraMap_eq_valuation _).trans hl') (q.finsetCongr.symm
    (Iio ⟨D.ceilLogM p, by omega⟩))).1 <;> simp [Units.ext_iff, j, d, Fin.lt_def, apply_ite,
      Equiv.finsetCongr]
steps.typed_fact: j l d ∈ basicDoubleCoset _ l (D.ceilLogM p)

steps.claim: P has finite index; ρ is integral above p; columnLevel 0 ⊆ K_f.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨_, r1, hKw⟩ := ofFinite (_ ⧸ P), (hρ' · ·), fun k : D.columnLevel 0 ↦
    mem_Kf_iff.1 (IsLevel.le k.2)

steps.claim: δ(x, β) := (ρ_x at l)⁻¹·j_l(jw β)·j_l(d).
steps.lean: let δ x β := ((ρ x).atPlace l)⁻¹ * (j l (jw β) * j l d)

steps.claim: For every class x and coset b of P: ρ_x·δ(x, b) = (rational γ_b)·ρ_{o(b)}·u_b with u_b in the level (`exists_eq_map_mul_rep_mul`).
steps.lean:
choose o γ u G using fun b : _ × _ ⧸ P ↦
    exists_eq_map_mul_rep_mul _ _ hρ (ρ b.1 * atSplit hl (δ b.1 b.2.out))

steps.claim: Rearranged form of that identity.
steps.lean: have H b := eq_mul_inv_of_mul_eq (eq_mul_inv_of_mul_eq (G b).symm)

steps.claim: γ_b = jw(b.out)·d·jw(g_b) for some g_b ∈ GL_k(W) (hw′).
steps.lean: choose g hg using fun b ↦ (@hw' ((jw b.2.out * d)⁻¹ * γ b)).1 (by simp [← hj, δ, *])

steps.claim: Rearranged form.
steps.lean: have hγ b := eq_mul_of_inv_mul_eq (hg b).symm

steps.claim: ε: Column ≃ functions on classes (free level); f: integral functions → Column, O_ι-linear; c: O_ι ⊂ ℂ.
steps.lean:
let ε : D.Column ≃ₗ[ℂ] _ := freeLevelEquiv _ _ 1 D.classAut_columnLevel_eq_bot hρ
  let f := ε.symm.1.restrictScalars _ ∘ₗ ((Algebra.linearMap embValRing ℂ).compLeft _).compLeft _
  let c := embValRing.subtype

steps.claim: hε: (f F)(ρ_y) = c ∘ F(y).
steps.lean: have hε F y : (f F).1.1 _ = c ∘ F y := congrFun (ε.4 _) y

steps.claim: At a place τ that is not a letter: a matrix m_{b,τ} ∈ GL(O_ι) with schur(κ_τ)(conj Φ_τ(γ_b)) = schur(m_{b,τ}): if τ is a top it does not induce l or l̄, so γ_b is integral and invertible there; otherwise κ_τ is a row of length 0 and m = 1.
steps.lean:
choose m hm using fun b (τ : Subtype (¬Q ·)) ↦ (if h : ↑τ ∈ D.tops then ((@hM (placeOfEmb
    (weightEmbedding ιₚ τ)) (γ b)).1 (by simp [← hj, r1 _ _ (natCast_mem_placeOfEmb _), by simpa [*,
    inducedPlace] using τ.2, H, hKw, placeOfEmb_comp_star, star_involutive.eq_iff])).elim (⟨.map
    (.restrict ((Φ τ).comp conj) _ _ fun _ ↦ (isEquiv_placeOfEmb _).le_one_iff_le_one.2) ·, · ▸
    rfl⟩) else ⟨1, Matrix.ext (by simp [by simpa using hψ (ite_eq_right h) 0])⟩ : ∃ m : GL _ _,
    schur (fun () ↦ D.κ τ) (fun _ ↦ (γ b).1.1.map (Φ τ ∘ conj)) = schur _ fun _ ↦ m.1.map c)

steps.claim: Apply `TwistingData.hasType_twisted_hecke` to f, the source map o, the matrices g_b⁻¹, the weight matrices of m at non-letters and the identification of index sets through t and ψ: it gives HasType for f.range and any operator with the explicit formula; remaining: f.range = integralColumns, the formula for markOperator (checked on class representatives), and injectivity of the source map.
steps.lean:
convert T.hasType_twisted_hecke hp big f o g⁻¹ ((weylRep _ 0).toHomUnits ∘ m) (.trans
    (.piEquivPiSubtypeProd Q _) (.prodCongr (t.piCongr fun s ↦ (ψ (ite_eq_left ((hS _).1 (t
    s).2).1)).symm.trans (.piUnique _)).symm (.refl _))) ?_ (fun F ↦ eq_of_eq_on_class_reps hρ ?_) _

steps.claim: f.range = integralColumns: a column is integral iff its values at the representatives have gauge ≤ 1, i.e. iff it is f of an integral function.
steps.lean:
refine le_antisymm (fun φ H ↦ ⟨fun c ↦ (⟨_, (weylGauge_le_one_iff _ (r1 c)).1
    (by simpa using H.2 _) ·⟩), ε.3 φ⟩) fun | _, ⟨F, rfl⟩ => ⟨by simp, fun g ↦ ?_⟩

steps.claim: For g, decompose g = rational·ρ_c·k.
steps.lean: choose c γ k _ using exists_eq_map_mul_rep_mul _ _ hρ g

steps.claim: Then (f F)(g) is integral.
steps.lean:
simp [levelSpace_smoothFormRep_apply (f F).2, weylGauge_mul, -mul_assoc, ↓weylGauge_embFin,
    weylGauge_le_one_iff, mem_localLevel, *]; use (F c · |>.2)

steps.claim: dim Column = #classes × dim(weight) (free level).
steps.lean: simp [finrank_levelSpace_smoothFormRep D.classAut_columnLevel_eq_bot]

steps.claim: Injectivity: let b, b′ have the same image.
steps.lean: simp_intro b b' h

steps.claim: Then the classes agree and the rational parts differ by an element of the level that is trivial (free level, `eq_and_eq_one_of_doubleCoset_rep`), and the cosets of P agree (hP, hw′): b = b′.
steps.lean:
use (eq_and_eq_one_of_doubleCoset_rep hρ ((map_eq_one_iff _ Fact.out).1 <|
    (D.classAut_columnLevel_eq_bot _).le ⟨⟨·, rfl⟩, ·⟩) (γ b * (γ b')⁻¹) ((mul_mem_cancel_right
    ((u b')⁻¹ * u b).2).1 (hv ((and_congr_left mem_Kf_iff_of_supportedOn).2 ⟨by
    simp [← mul_assoc, *, -H, -hg, -hM]
    simpa [mul_mem_cancel_left, hw', r1, hpl, (Units.ext (diagonal_transpose _) : invTransposeGL d =
      d⁻¹)] using! hM.2 ((invTransposeGL_mem_intGL _).2 (hM.1 (hP.2 h.2))), by simp +contextual [H,
    h]⟩)))).elim fun e f ↦ Prod.ext e (Quotient.out_equiv_out.1 (QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.2 (hP.1
    (hw'.2 ⟨g b * (g b')⁻¹, by simp [hg, mul_inv_eq_one.1 f]⟩))))

steps.claim: The operator formula: unfold markOperator; the Hecke operator at l is the sum over the cosets of P of pullbacks by δ (`heckeFun_eq_sum_pullback`); a side condition on the double coset is left.
steps.lean:
ext x; dsimp [IsMarked.markOperator]; erw [(heckeFun_eq_sum_pullback (J :=
    P) _ ((mem_sphericalAt_iff hl).1 (levelSpace_anti hv (f
    F).2)) univ (δ x) (fun z h ↦ ?_) (by simp [δ, ← hP]) _).2] <;> simp [δ, *, -hM, -map_mul]

steps.claim: Per coset b, insert the decomposition of step 14.
steps.lean: congr with b; erw [G (x, b)]

steps.claim: Evaluate the forms at the decomposed points (level space, weight representation).
steps.lean:
simp [levelSpace_smoothFormRep_apply (f F).2, stdSpace_weightRep_apply, weylRep, lastEntry,
    mulVec, dotProduct, ← mul_assoc, hε]

steps.claim: Write the weight action as a product over places, split into letters (Q) and the rest, and account for p^{A_l} and the depth powers.
steps.lean:
congr! 2; rw [pow_mul', ← prod_const, prod_filter, ← prod_pow, schur_apply_eq_prod .refl,
    schur_apply_eq_prod .refl, ← prod_subtype_mul_prod_subtype Q, ← t.prod_comp, ← mul_rotate',
    diagonal_pow_depth, map_prod]

steps.claim: Letter representation and Kronecker products.
steps.lean:
simp_rw [letterRep_apply, ← kroneckerPi_mul, ← map_mul, ← prod_mul_distrib, kroneckerPi, of_apply,
    map_prod]

steps.claim: Non-letter factors agree by m (step 20); letter factors by ψ and `symPowMatrix_map`; the letter matrices remain.
steps.lean:
refine congr((∏ τ, $((hm ..).trans (schur_map .refl ..)) _ _) * ∏ s, $((hψ ..).trans
    (congrFun₂ ((congrArg _ ?_).trans (symPowMatrix_map c _)) ..))); clear * - hc hγ e

steps.claim: Letter matrices, by the parity of s: entries of γ⁻¹ (= conjugate transpose, unitary) times the powers of p; `omega` closes the index arithmetic.
steps.lean:
have := NeZero.ne p
  cases _ : T.isEven s <;> ext <;> (try apply congr(p * Φ _ ($(@id ((γ _).1⁻¹.1 =
    _) (U.inv_val_eq_conjTranspose _)) _ _)).symm.trans) <;> simp [*, letterMatrix, deepIndicator,
    mul_apply, diagonal, ← map_inv, jw, d, reindex_equiv q,
    -sum_sum_type] <;> congr with <;> split_ifs <;> simp [*, ϖ, c, field] <;> omega

steps.claim: The side condition: an element z of the basic double coset is j_l(d) up to K_l on both sides; choose k₁, then γ, a, b with integrality above p (`exists_mul_mem_integralAbove`), and β with jw(β) equal to the resulting element of K_l; use β⁻¹.
steps.lean:
choose k₁ _ _ _ h using by simpa [basicDoubleCoset_eq hD, DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset] using h
  choose γ a b using exists_mul_mem_integralAbove p (ρ x * atSplit hl k₁) (atSplit hl (j l d)⁻¹)
  choose β _ using hw'.1 (by simpa [*] using a l hpl)
  use β⁻¹; simpa [← mul_assoc, *] using b l hpl
